versions.name: Campamento de Verano (Summer Camp)
versions.address: PR-119 Km 23.9, Barrio Guajataca San Sebastian, Puerto Rico

features.note: A lakeside waterfront plus two pools, all staffed by certified aquatics personnel.
A supervised archery range described as a favourite of visiting Cub Scout and Scouts BSA units.
Star watching, including guided night walks from the nature lodge.
Backpacking routes graded from beginner to advanced in the terrain around the camp.
A fleet of about thirty-five canoes.
A modern hall seating five hundred, serving fresh meals daily.
An infirmary staffed around the clock by certified personnel, with ambulance service.
Guided expeditions for more experienced campers, including one to the headwaters of the river.
Guided walks to see birds, stars and forest species, notably through the mahogany stand.
A nature lodge running its own classes and hosting the guided nature walks.
Two pools with certified aquatics staff.
Rowboats are part of the waterfront fleet.
On the shore of the lake, with an observation tower over the water and a fleet of canoes, kayaks, paddleboards, rowboats and sailboats.
Bird watching is a regular guided activity.
